sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which texture do you feel when you touch a dry autumn leaf?
When drawing 'People in Action', which type of line shows movement best?
options: A) A perfectly straight vertical line
B) A curved or diagonal line
questions.answer: B) A curved or diagonal line

questions.question_text: What colors would you mostly use to paint a realistic 'Aqua World'?
Which of these is a natural texture found in nature?
When arranging objects for a drawing, what is an important rule to follow?
options: A) Hide all the objects behind each other
B) Place them so they overlap slightly but all can be seen
C) Make every object the exact same size
D) Paint them all the same dark color
questions.answer: B) Place them so they overlap slightly but all can be seen

questions.question_text: Which tool is best for blending pencil colors to create a soft, smooth look?
options: B) A piece of cotton or tissue
questions.answer: B) A piece of cotton or tissue

questions.question_text: If you want to draw a person running, how should their legs look?
options: A) Standing straight and close together
B) Sitting crossed on the floor
C) Bent at the knees and spaced apart
questions.answer: C) Bent at the knees and spaced apart

questions.question_text: What do we call a drawing made entirely from our own mind without looking at anything?
Which animal would you most likely draw in an 'Aqua World' scene?
What basic geometric shape is a traditional drum (like a dholak or conga) mostly based on?
How do you show that an object is far away in your drawing? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To show an object is far away, I draw it much smaller than the objects in the front and place it higher up on the paper.

questions.question_text: Describe the difference in texture between a pineapple and a mango. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A pineapple has a rough, bumpy, and prickly texture. A mango has a very smooth, soft, and slightly waxy texture on its outer skin.

questions.question_text: Name three creatures you would find in an Aqua World and mention their colors. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I would find a bright orange starfish, a shiny silver dolphin, and a green sea turtle swimming through the deep blue ocean water.

questions.question_text: Why is it helpful to 'look around' nature before starting a new artwork? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Looking around helps us find new ideas, notice beautiful colors, and observe interesting shapes in nature that inspire us to create a very unique drawing.

questions.question_text: What facial expressions and body parts show a person is jumping with joy? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A wide smiling face, eyes open big, arms thrown high up in the air, and both feet lifted off the ground show joyful jumping.

questions.question_text: Imagine you found a magic tree in the forest. Describe its leaves, trunk, and the textures it has. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The magic tree has a twisted trunk covered in smooth, golden bark that glows softly. Its leaves are shaped like perfect tiny diamonds that feel as soft as velvet, changing colors from bright purple to neon pink whenever the wind blows.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are arranging three magical objects on a table. What are they and how are they arranged? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I place a glowing crystal ball in the very center. On its left, there is a tall, twisting silver wand. On its right, I place a small wooden box covered in rough dragon scales. They are arranged in a neat triangle.

questions.question_text: If you had to create a drawing titled 'People in Action' at a busy market, what actions would you draw them doing? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would draw a shopkeeper holding out a basket of red apples to a customer. Nearby, a small child is stretching their arms up to grab a colorful balloon. In the background, a person is walking fast while balancing a large, heavy sack of rice smoothly on their head.

questions.question_text: How would you use colors and shapes to express the feeling of anger in an abstract painting? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To express anger, I would use dark and strong colors like deep red, black, and dark orange. I would draw sharp, jagged shapes like lightning bolts and triangles instead of smooth circles. I would make thick, messy brush strokes pushing hard against the paper to show strong, powerful energy.
